'''Section 53-T''' was a section of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] legal texts that regulated the matters of contraband violation. In [[3638 BBY]], it was invoked in the [[Imperial Edict GR-1NC4]] to forbid the purchase and possession of goods sold by the [[Master of Ceremonies]] and his [[Life Day Revelers]].<ref name="Holonet">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20131216|text=IMPERIAL EDICT GR-1NC4}}</ref>
